earmark_detector → EARMARK_SUNSET (Tester lost seat post Nov-2024; Cardin/Van Hollen/Hoyer support insufficient to renew)

scores.interpretation: RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE. The single most material government-customer relationship named in Item 1 (AFRL) is a Pentagon program that has been ZEROED for two consecutive FYs and whose congressional sponsor structure has collapsed (EARMARK_SUNSET). The Wolfpack pattern: $51M FY22-24 IONQ revenue from AFRL was never requested by Pentagon — entirely a congressional add. With sponsor power gone, the de-funding is structurally durable, not a CR-timing artifact. Heuristic 5 (Earmark sub-signal) explicitly bumps UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS up one tier — already at the top. Heuristic 6 (USAspending cross-check) confirms IONQ received the historical contracts they claim — so past revenue was real but forward pipeline is gone.

IonQ publicly characterized the Qubitekk win as a $21.1M contract while only $8.9M is currently funded (the remainder is unfunded ceiling). The same political-fragility pattern that sunk the AFRL Quantum Networking earmark could repeat. Downgraded one tier from PASS to MODERATE to reflect the ceiling-vs-funded disclosure gap and earmark fragility.

Heuristic 6: USAspending past contracts confirm IonQ won real contracts, but the J-Book shows the forward funding is not there to convert the unfunded RPO into cash. Failure to disclose the unfunded composition is an investor-relevant gap.
